review_scope: Main-session model-card review and deterministic identity/hash checks. Only public documentation and selected repository metadata were retrieved. No model weights, executable source files, datasets, hosted inference, containers or training were downloaded or run; no subagent review is claimed.

records.title: Amos 1 large
records.limitations: The card reports English-only operation, possible truncation of long extracted quotes and 80 GB GPU requirements. Comparison rows mix publisher measurements with one competitor-reported number; the index result covers the public suite. Serving correctness and calibration were not reproduced.

records.title: KnowLine-35B-A3B-Gen1
records.limitations: The publisher selected among ten candidates using public-suite score and release checks. Related benchmark task formats and source passages occur in training; teacher labels are not all human checked. Calibration ranges use plausible benchmark subsets, and the adapted Mind2Web task is easier than the original protocol. No data audit or experiment was performed.

records.title: Lychee-27B
records.limitations: The card reports public Decision Index measurements, not an independently verified full private-suite result. Its own model license is CC BY-NC 4.0 despite the Apache-2.0 base. The documented context and memory behavior was not tested.

records.title: Span-02
records.limitations: The current card documents a dedicated engine, Blackwell hardware, optional generated reasoning and different default/index budgets. Typed number answers use a different confidence definition. Claimed rankings, throughput and latency were not rerun. The legacy Hub account redirects to respanai; one resource is counted.

alias_evidence.interpretation: The old account and current account are one model identity despite changed README bytes. Canonicalization also serves scanner identity; a similarly prefixed model remains distinct.

license_cross_check.observation: The upstream link in the Span-02 card resolves to the official Apache License 2.0 page. No legal permission beyond the stated licenses is inferred.

counting: Each reviewed family contributes one model repository. Other Amos sizes, KnowLine sizes/generations, Perplexity release variants, file-level assets and the legacy Span account contribute zero new counts. Existing ledgers and baseline bytes are preserved.
regression: A fixture with legacy/current model URLs and an unrelated near-prefix model failed with three unique resources before the alias rule and passed with two afterward. Index and scanner identity agree.
privacy: No contact addresses, raw card text, credentials, private paths or account details are published.
